support_ownership_cutoffs.effect: Current model/umpire workspace/config files own the active root; parent model Cargo/config stays provenance only. Never map mixed parent Cargo files onto current Cargo files.
Old model/dev/xtask prefix stops mapping to active dev/xtask; its retained Temporal extension is not generic. Current framework prefix includes the guest-driver/xtask split.
Current model/umpire/scripts are authoritative active scripts; model/scripts wrappers and Temporal controls stay provenance only.

filter_algorithm: Restrict export to H; do not use --all or source branch tips beyond this fixed source.
Compute ancestry sets against original commit IDs before filtering; membership uses graph ancestry rather than timestamps or callback order.

For each original commit, project its complete original tree through the qualified prefix rules and exact support allowlist. Fail on any duplicate destination unless all source entries have identical blob and mode; record any identical aliases.

Emit a deterministic projected-tree diff against the projected original first parent, retaining original parent relationships and original authors/committers/dates/messages. Handle root commits with an empty parent tree. Account explicitly for any empty/pruned commits in the commit map.

Do not implement only a per-file-change rename: move commits may delete an old prefix and add the same target via a new prefix; sibling moves and their merge must resolve from complete original snapshots.

In the isolated clone only, preserve provenance support through the history export, then remove .history-support in a separate explicit layout commit. That deletion must not hide support paths from prior history.

Compare the selected current active projection (excluding history-support) against every source-manifest record: destination, raw blob bytes, executable/symlink mode, and symlink target. The expected active count is 1189 including LICENSE.
Verify both archive-move histories, old host paths and native-tool split in the resulting commit map; rerun representative history queries against mapped revisions before layout adaptation.
collision_constraints: The historical model/umpire prefix contains Scala before R; prefix-only --path filtering imports the wrong language history.
6264f11760 and 0fc76f7805 are sibling archive moves with the same parent; both are reachable and joined at e87ee28f2d.
At framework/host/tool move commits old-prefix deletion and new-prefix insertion can share one projected destination; use original-tree projection and deterministic diff.
The current parent model/dev/xtask is Temporal-owned; retaining it after the split would overwrite generic dev/xtask source.
Shared parent manifests/locks/config/scripts and root Makefile/mise files must never overwrite current standalone-owned files.
Preserve snapshot metadata files and golden payloads individually; no semantic golden changes or generated-code edits are part of history export.
